name: 4-Phase Geared Stepper & Driver
description: Like clockwork gears! Steps precisely 2048 steps per full revolution with high torque.
realWorldAnalogy: Like clockwork gears! Steps precisely 2048 steps per full revolution with high torque.
wiringGuidance: Connect ULN2003 + (Red) to 5V, - (Dark Slate) to GND, and IN1-IN4 (Green wires) to digital pins 8, 9, 10, 11.
commonMistakes: Trying to drive stepper coils directly from micro pins without the ULN2003 driver.
Incorrect phase stepping sequence making the motor vibrate in place without turning.

miniExperiment.title: Precision Stepper Revolution
miniExperiment.circuit: IN1-IN4 to Pins 8-11, Power to 5V & GND.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: The stepper shaft completes a full 360-degree rotation clockwise, pauses, and reverses.
